SELECT ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_NO, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, DATA_TYPE, DESCR , SUM(HTSV) HTSV, SUM(HAE) HAE FROM( SELECT PR.ITEM_TYPE, PR.ITEM_NO, PR.ITEM_ID, PR.ITEM_NAME, PR.DATA_TYPE, PR.DESCR, decode(cpny_id, 'HTSV', 1, null) HTSV, decode(cpny_id, 'HAE', 1, null) HAE FROM (SELECT P.PARAM_ITEM_NO ITEM_NO, P.PARAM_ITEM_ID ITEM_ID, SY2.CONTENT ITEM_NAME, P.DATA_TYPE, P.DESCR , P.ITEM_TYPE FROM PA_PARAM_ITEM P,SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2 WHERE P.PARAM_ITEM_NO = SY2.NO(+) AND P.ACTIVITY=1 AND SY2.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) PR LEFT JOIN PA_PARAM_ITEM_PARAM PT ON PR.ITEM_NO = PT.PARAM_ITEM_NO AND PT.ACTIVITY=1 UNION ALL SELECT 6 ITEM_TYPE, PS.ITEM_NO, PS.ITEM_ID, PS.ITEM_NAME, PS.DATA_TYPE, PS.DESCR, decode(cpny_id, 'HTSV', 1, null) HTSV, decode(cpny_id, 'HAE', 1, null) HAE FROM (SELECT PA.ITEM_NO, PA.ITEM_ID, SY3.CONTENT ITEM_NAME, PA.DATATYPE DATA_TYPE, PA.DESCR FROM PA_ITEM PA,SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY3 WHERE PA.ITEM_NO = SY3.NO(+) AND PA.ACTIVITY=1 AND SY3.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) PS LEFT JOIN PA_ITEM_PARAM PP ON PS.ITEM_NO = PP.ITEM_NO AND PP.ACTIVITY=1 ) SD
ITEM_ID LIKE '%' || #ITEM_ID:VARCHAR# || '%'
ITEM_NO = #ITEM_NO:NUMERIC#
ITEM_NO = #NO:NUMERIC#
ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%'
ITEM_TYPE LIKE '%' || #TYPE:NUMERIC# || '%'
HTSV = 1
HAE = 1
ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$
group by SD.ITEM_TYPE, SD.ITEM_NO, SD.ITEM_ID, SD.ITEM_NAME, SD.DATA_TYPE, SD.DESCR

MM.ITEM_ID LIKE '%' || #ITEM_ID:VARCHAR# || '%'
MM.ITEM_NO = #ITEM_NO:NUMERIC#
